objections.claim: Step 8 mandates "Run all eight steps (section 8) at PIN", and step 3 asserts every cited path with `git cat-file -e PIN:<path>`. But the revised map — the document the steps run against — exists only on the build branch, and it will name paths the revision itself creates: step 6c.v requires the gaps finding to tell operators to reproduce with `--root test/fixtures/faff-826-map-root`, and the revised "no file under `test/` was added…" line must state what the revision touched. If either is written as a full repo-relative path with an extension (the natural way, and the form the prior run's conservative extraction rule picks up), `git cat-file -e PIN:test/fixtures/...` fails — the fixture is committed after PIN by step 10's own ordering. The spec then traps the builder: step 8 says "a failure blocks the map and is fixed, never narrowed", so the builder cannot resolve it by excluding the path, and cannot resolve it by committing the fixture before PIN. The procedure as written cannot pass without an unstated deviation.
objections.evidence: Build procedure steps 8 and 3; step 6c.v; step 10's commit order; the smoke-test section's "Every step must pass; a failure blocks the map and is fixed, never narrowed."
objections.predicted_consequence: The builder either silently deviates from the pinned procedure (undermining the smoke test's evidentiary value for FAFF-827) or the recorded smoke test reports a failure that is an artefact of the procedure, not of the map.

objections.claim: Step 6d adds the live-map tripwire "ALWAYS (whatever 6b decided)", asserting the live map's parsed set equals the literal PARSED_AFTER list. Step 10 then says: "If step 6c ran, commit the fixture and the test edit BEFORE the map edit, so every commit passes CI." When the parsed set changes (the expected case, since `shadow-fidelity` is expected to classify `decision-kernel`), the tripwire committed before the map edit runs against the *old* live map, parses PARSED_BEFORE, and fails its equality assertion with PARSED_AFTER. The two steps contradict each other: the commit ordering chosen to keep CI green guarantees one red commit.
objections.evidence: Step 6d ("ALWAYS … with PARSED_AFTER as its literal list") versus step 10 ("commit the fixture and the test edit BEFORE the map edit, so every commit passes CI").
objections.predicted_consequence: The branch's intermediate commit fails the unit job in CI, violating the DONE constraint "The PR's CI checks pass" as applied per-commit and defeating the stated purpose of the ordering.
objections.spec_anchor: build-procedure (the `PROCEDURE refresh_state_authority_map` block; no separate heading slug for step 10, nearest is `4-how`)

objections.claim: The DONE item requires the PR body to record whether `REGION_MAP` gained keys between pin and PR head, and to "re-pin before merge" if so — but the spec never says what a re-pin entails. Steps 2–8 (snapshot digest, PARSED_BEFORE/AFTER, the tripwire's literal list, the sweep, the smoke test) are all pinned to the build-start sha; nothing states they are recomputed at the new pin.
objections.evidence: "From why" done item: "The PR body records whether `REGION_MAP` gained keys between the pin and the PR's head; if it did, the build re-pins before merge." Procedure step 1 pins once; no step re-runs on re-pin.
objections.predicted_consequence: A merged map whose header names the new pin while its row set, sweep, and the tripwire test's literal PARSED_AFTER list were derived at the old pin — the tripwire then either fails CI (forcing an unreviewed literal edit) or, worse, passes against a classification that was never re-traced at the pin the map claims.
